name: ship-it
description: SHIP IT — a tiny one-button developer arcade game to play while Codex works. Your agent codes. You survive production.

interface.shortDescription: A tiny arcade game for while Codex works
interface.longDescription: SHIP IT is a one-button endless runner themed around shipping software: jump BUG, 404, MERGE CONFLICT and other developer disasters, chain PERFECT jumps into FLOW STATE, and rack up deployments. Meant to be opened for a couple of minutes while a longer Codex task runs, then closed again. Runs entirely in the browser at ship-it-prod-2026.web.app; local high score is stored on your device, and the global leaderboard is public (no account needed).
